we propose in this paper an IoT monitoring architecture that exploits RPL capabilities to perform passive network monitoring without impacting resource constrained nodes.

(i) the RPL protocol can be used to support passive monitoring in the IoT, (ii) the RPL monitoring architecture is able to monitor network flows and events without having any impact on the resource constrained devices, (iii) it is able to detect anomalies in the network and (iv) it is able, to a certain extent, to detect the location of the anomaly.
